questions.text: Is the cough bringing up sputum?
questions.why: Sputum favours lower respiratory infection or airway disease.

questions.text: Has the cough lasted more than 3 weeks?
questions.why: Prolonged cough raises TB and other chronic causes.

questions.text: Any blood in the sputum?
questions.why: Haemoptysis needs TB, PE, cancer and bronchiectasis considered.

questions.text: Any wheeze or whistling breathing?
questions.why: Suggests airway obstruction (asthma/COPD).

questions.text: Smoking, or long exposure to cooking-fire smoke or dust?
questions.why: Major risk factor for COPD and lung disease.

questions.text: Drenching sweats at night?
questions.why: Infection (TB) and malignancy question.

questions.text: Unintentional weight loss?
questions.why: Chronic infection or malignancy question.

questions.text: Contact with someone with TB, or past TB?
questions.why: Exposure raises TB probability in India.

questions.text: Worse breathlessness lying flat, or waking breathless at night?
questions.why: Typical of heart failure.

questions.text: Swelling of both ankles/feet?
questions.why: Heart, kidney or liver cause question.

questions.text: Runny or blocked nose, or mucus dripping down the throat?
questions.why: Upper airway cause of cough.

questions.text: Does coughing or choking happen while or after eating or drinking?
questions.why: May suggest aspiration or swallowing problem.

questions.text: High fever with shaking chills?
questions.why: Typical teaching feature of malaria; also bacterial infection.

questions.text: Has the fever lasted more than 5 days, rising stepwise?
questions.why: Prolonged fever raises enteric fever, TB and others.

questions.text: Any new skin rash?
questions.why: Rash helps separate dengue, meningococcal illness and viral fevers.

questions.lbl: Pain behind eyes / severe body ache
questions.text: Pain behind the eyes or severe body and joint aches?
questions.why: Common dengue presentation.

questions.text: Lives in or travelled to an area with dengue or malaria, or mosquito bites?
questions.why: Exposure history for vector-borne disease.

questions.text: Pain or stiffness in the neck?
questions.why: Meningeal irritation is a cannot-miss feature.

questions.text: Does bright light hurt the eyes or worsen the headache?
questions.why: Seen in migraine and meningitis.

questions.text: Any confusion, drowsiness or behaviour change?
questions.why: Altered consciousness is a danger sign.

questions.text: Too breathless to speak full sentences, or breathless at rest?
questions.why: Danger sign needing urgent assessment.

questions.text: Did breathlessness start suddenly (minutes to hours)?
questions.why: Sudden onset raises PE, pneumothorax, acute heart problems.

questions.text: Recent surgery, long bed rest or long travel?
questions.why: Risk factor for venous thromboembolism.

questions.text: Swelling and pain in one leg only?
questions.why: Possible deep vein thrombosis.

questions.lbl: Pressure-type chest pain (exertion/rest, spreading to arm/jaw)
questions.text: Is the pain a heavy pressure or tightness, brought on by effort or at rest, spreading to arm, jaw or back?
questions.why: Typical ischaemic cardiac pain features.

questions.text: Sweating, nausea or feeling of doom with the pain?
questions.why: Autonomic features support ACS.

questions.text: Is the pain sharp and worse on deep breath or coughing?
questions.why: Pleuritic pain: pneumonia, PE, pleurisy, pneumothorax.

questions.lbl: Sudden tearing pain to the back
questions.text: Sudden severe tearing pain spreading to the back?
questions.why: Aortic dissection is a cannot-miss cause.

questions.text: Did the headache reach maximum severity within about a minute, or is it the worst ever?
questions.why: Thunderclap headache needs urgent exclusion of bleeding.

questions.text: One-sided, throbbing headache with nausea, repeated in past?
questions.why: Typical migraine pattern.

questions.text: Any weakness, numbness, speech trouble, double vision or seizure?
questions.why: Focal deficit means structural or vascular cause until proven otherwise.

questions.lbl: Head injury or on blood thinners
questions.text: Recent head injury, or taking warfarin/other blood thinners?
questions.why: Raises risk of intracranial bleeding.

questions.text: Is the headache steadily worsening over days to weeks, worse in the morning or on coughing?
questions.why: Possible raised intracranial pressure.

questions.lbl: Pain moved to right lower abdomen
questions.text: Did pain start near the navel and move to the right lower abdomen?
questions.why: Classic appendicitis migration.

questions.text: Is a period late or missed, or could she be pregnant?
questions.why: Ectopic pregnancy must be excluded in women of reproductive age.

questions.text: Any vaginal bleeding?
questions.why: Supports ectopic or other gynaecological cause.

questions.text: Street food, untreated water, or others ill after the same meal?
questions.why: Faeco-oral infection exposure.

questions.text: Blood or mucus in the stool?
questions.why: Suggests invasive infection or inflammatory bowel disease.

questions.text: Has the patient had thoughts of harming themselves or ending their life?
questions.why: Safety question applies in any consultation.
